raw_segments.text: And he the future evil shall no less in apprehension than in substance feel, grievous to bear.
But that care now is past, man is not whom to warn.
Those few escaped famine and anguish will at last consume, wandering that watery disheart.
When violence was ceased, and war on earth, all would have then gone well.
Peace would have crowned with length of happy days the race of man.
